profile.summary: Seasoned Full Stack Engineer with over a decade of experience leading teams and delivering reliable, scalable software solutions. Known for strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a commitment to excellence in fast-paced environments. Brings a collaborative, customer-focused mindset, with a track record of mentoring others, embracing new technologies, and consistently delivering results with integrity, accountability, and precision—even under pressure or off-hours.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: City of Industry, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Leverage AI-driven development workflows using ChatGPT and Claude Code to accelerate modernization efforts, automate development tasks, and significantly improve engineering productivity.
- Develop and maintain full-stack enterprise applications using ASP.NET, MS SQL Server, and Next.js.
- Design and optimize backend APIs and frontend architectures to improve system performance, scalability, and maintainability.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, business-driven solutions.
- Lead modernization initiatives for legacy ASP.NET WebForms applications through refactoring, architectural improvements, and migration strategies.
- Optimize MS SQL Server performance through query tuning, schema design, and database normalization.
- Troubleshoot complex production issues and enhance system reliability in a fast-paced development environment.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Improved server performance, reducing CPU and memory usage from 90% to 15%.
Led team mentorship, performing code reviews, API integrations, and security audits.
Implemented secure authentication using JWT, OAuth 2.0, and MFA; enforced RBAC, input validation, and encryption.
Built scalable, containerized web services with n-tier architecture following Agile development practices.
Developed SPAs with React and designed responsive UI using Tailwind CSS.
Designed and optimized CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, improving build and test reliability, and integrated automated test suites to support large-scale deployments.
Developed automated testing infrastructure using PowerShell and Python scripts, reducing regression errors and improving release quality.
Built an AI-assisted query engine using OpenAI API (ChatGPT), delivering personalized search experiences within the web platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Solution Architect
positions.description:
Implemented secure microservices using C# with .NET and AWS, ensuring data integrity and end-to-end encryption.
Designed and managed CI/CD pipelines with Docker, AWS CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, and integrated automated build/test validation systems for secure deployments.
Led security compliance initiatives, including SOC 2 Type II preparation, access control policies, and API security hardening.
Utilized AWS EC2, and RDS to enforce least privilege access controls across cloud infrastructure.
Developed audit logging and real-time threat monitoring for application security.

projects.title: Franchise Platform
projects.description:
Developed a scalable, SEO-optimized platform enabling franchise businesses to promote their brands globally with multilingual support and targeted marketing tools to attract investors and buyers

This project aims to develop an integrated platform that empowers franchise businesses to effectively promote their brands online and attract more franchisees. The platform is designed to showcase franchises in a way that highlights their unique value propositions, enabling brands to connect with potential franchisees more efficiently.

By leveraging a user-friendly interface and personalized recommendations, the platform enhances the visibility of franchise opportunities. It also provides tools for brands to manage inquiries and monitor performance metrics, supporting their efforts to expand and strengthen their franchise networks.

The project is structured with a clear implementation and release timeline, ensuring high-quality delivery through phased development and rigorous testing.

projects.title: Auction Management System
projects.description:
Developed a fundraising platform where funds from multiple investors are utilized for auctions and flipping, generating profits.
Expenditures and details for profit generation are transparently visible on the customer portal and managed on the admin page. 
Dividends are paid to investors mid-fund, with the liquidated amount distributed at the fund's conclusion.
Tech stack: AWS EC2, S3, and Route 53, Vue3.js, Node.js, Laravel, PHP, MySQL, REST API, and Linux
